question: Which public contract and current-state representation can eliminate authored reload reconstruction while preserving causal, anchor, retention and editable-view laws?
method: Best API design; redesign from first principles; embedded Benchmark pre-acceptance comparison; best-api-review/history-v2
trigger: User go on the preceding loadable-state design recommendation; design and disposable probes only.
requirements: Remove full operation reduction and pending-edit replay as the authority for opening current state; reconsider all public owners and stored copies before preserving them.
Keep normal and retention-customized call sites complete and truthful, with exact existing import paths, native ownership and no extra loader, trusted-input switch or application cache controller.
Preserve accepted document authority, canonical changes, stable contribution/origin identities, dependencies, atomic decisions, named roots, retained history and delayed-peer laws.

Run a frozen serial comparison against a fresh optimized native baseline; include complete decoding/read, source identity, original content/author oracle, corruption controls, save and first-operation diagnostics.
Require at least 50 percent and one second reduction, three fresh-process nonoverlapping ranges per claimed runtime; never accept a subset decoder as an equivalent native editor.
Record versioning, breaking scope, retention limits and the exact remaining runtime gate. No product mutation, publication or reset of the completed three production trials.
evidenceReuse: Reconsidered the preceding scalability record and inspected current native state/restore, public types, raw example, Discussion/AI call sites and shared-effect checkpoint. Twelve of the prior 193 Plite inputs and additional Yjs/UI consumers changed before this packet; previous full suites are historical only. Fresh baseline and candidate bundles capture 201 and 202 input entries and match at closeout. One bounded same-model worker authored only the detached retained-content codec; root consumed it and owned all timed processes and persistent proof. No independent model-family review is claimed.
summary: Retain initialValue/read.value and the optional authored capability. Prefer directly validated current authored facts over accepted roots; keep unified retained content as the structural challenger. The retained independent-text decoder clears the cost gate at about 68/72 ms versus 2.51 s native and 5.19 MB versus 17.12 MB. Reject the tested 44.25 MB redundant mirror control. Defer production runtime acceptance because the subset lacks native/causal semantics and incremental decisions; Task owns the remaining coupled Plite format/runtime/retention/proof job.
alternatives: Keep/configure: preserve measured bulk wins and the current native path as control. Further constant-factor optimization leaves two reconstruction passes; no fourth production trial was run.
Existing public contract: retain initialValue, read.value, authored authorId/retainHistory and exact-view intent/projection. Change the internal versioned codec, not the application loading protocol.

Delete/merge: remove operation replay as current-state reconstruction authority and separately saved projection/cache controllers. Keep canonical DocumentChange, optional native authored capability, exact views, stable identities and existing transport/history owners for their independent jobs.

Redundant live-state mirrors: tested with and without replay consistency validation. Bigger and no faster at 10000; unchecked control admits inconsistent projected text and defers substantial work to the first edit. Reject this control, not every possible compact checkpoint validator.

Direct current facts over accepted roots: preferred bounded format family. Bulk-build derived indexes from retained content/identity/placement/causal facts; topology and structural/property validation remain unaccepted.

Unified retained-content tree: strongest larger replacement; text subset supports its cost premise. Whole-document authority, schema, native transactions, moves and conflict semantics remain unproved. The decoder is not a chosen runtime.

Archive history: separate body lifetime from identity lifetime. All fixture changes are pending; closed-history pruning cannot solve that load. Arbitrary delayed peers and anchors prevent silently forgetting required facts.

Marks/ranges, whole-editor replacement or mandatory CRDT: no matched evidence earns replacement of current native semantics or independent document-editing ownership. New loading controllers, trust flags and background replay add no justified public job.
proofLimits: Cost gate passes only for a detached independent-plain-text insertion representation. Native current baseline and candidate differ semantically. Candidate guards cover exact native text/author/status, detachment, identity/offset conservation, detached insert/accept/reject, save/reload and ten malformed inputs; no native anchor API, causal sequence/collision admission, stale decisions, dependencies, deleted/structural/property/root content, history compensation, retained-memory/closed-history scale or delayed-peer convergence. Detached commands scan all content; decision timings select different independent IDs and are not matched ratios. Old-format conversion costs 2.71 s once. Original full tests do not certify changed current Yjs/UI inputs. No product/browser/native-device, universal scalability or ProseMirror superiority claim.
